Add an Interactive Vector Drawing Toolbar (add_draw_toolbar)

Source: R/controls.R
add_draw_toolbar.Rd

Drop-in GPU equivalent of leaflet.extras::addDrawToolbar() with matching formals and Shiny reactive events!

Usage

add_draw_toolbar(
  map,
  targetGroup = NULL,
  position = c("topleft", "topright", "bottomleft", "bottomright", "top-left",
    "top-right", "bottom-left", "bottom-right", "top-center", "bottom-center",
    "center-left", "center-right"),
  polylineOptions = TRUE,
  polygonOptions = TRUE,
  circleOptions = TRUE,
  rectangleOptions = TRUE,
  markerOptions = TRUE,
  circleMarkerOptions = FALSE,
  editOptions = TRUE,
  singleFeature = FALSE,
  direction = c("vertical", "horizontal"),
  order = 15,
  toolbar = NULL
)

Arguments

map

A glmap widget or glmap_proxy.

targetGroup

Optional group name for drawn features (default "drawn_features").

position

Toolbar position: "topleft", "topright", "bottomleft", "bottomright" (or "top-left", etc.).

polylineOptions

List of options or TRUE/FALSE to enable/disable the polyline tool (default TRUE).

polygonOptions

List of options or TRUE/FALSE to enable/disable the polygon tool (default TRUE).

circleOptions

List of options or TRUE/FALSE to enable/disable the geodesic circle tool (default TRUE).

rectangleOptions

List of options or TRUE/FALSE to enable/disable the rectangle tool (default TRUE).

markerOptions

List of options or TRUE/FALSE to enable/disable the point marker tool (default TRUE).

circleMarkerOptions

List of options or TRUE/FALSE to enable/disable the circle marker tool (default FALSE).

editOptions

List of options or TRUE/FALSE to enable/disable feature deletion/clearing (default TRUE).

singleFeature

Logical; if TRUE, drawing a new feature replaces previous drawn features (default FALSE).

direction

Layout flow direction for the draw toolbar buttons: "vertical" (default) or "horizontal".

order

Numeric draw order within the anchor zone (default 15).

toolbar

Optional custom button titles created via draw_toolbar_options().

Value

Updated glmap widget or glmap_proxy.

Details

Supports interactive drawing of Polygons (click vertices, double-click or click first vertex to close), Rectangles (click-drag), Circles (click center, drag radius in meters), Polylines (click vertices, double-click to finish), and Markers (click), plus clearing/deleting drawn shapes.

Shiny Events Emitted (100% compatible with leaflet.extras::addDrawToolbar):

For a map with outputId = "map":

  • input$map_draw_start: list(feature_type = ...) when a drawing tool is activated.

  • input$map_draw_stop: list(feature_type = ...) when drawing finishes or is cancelled.

  • input$map_draw_new_feature: GeoJSON Feature list(type = "Feature", properties = list(_leaflet_id = id, feature_type = "polygon"|"rectangle"|"circle"|"polyline"|"marker", radius = r_meters), geometry = list(type = ..., coordinates = ...), wkt = "POLYGON ((...))", bbox = c(xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax)).

  • input$map_draw_deleted_features: GeoJSON FeatureCollection of deleted features.

  • input$map_draw_all_features: GeoJSON FeatureCollection of all currently drawn features.
